# BTO X•BOOK 16X1590 Plus+ live configurator

Source: https://bto.eu/product/bto-xbook-16x1590-plus/

The live configurator proves a 2026 Benelux family with 290HX Plus, RTX 5080, Belgian AZERTY/US International, 500-nit 99% P3 IPS, 2x TB4, 2x USB-A, 2.5GbE, three M.2 slots and paid three-year pickup-and-return coverage. It also proves two material contradictions: the family table says RTX 5080 `150–175W` and 330W adapter, whereas the selectable RTX 5080 motherboard entries say 115W + 25W Dynamic Boost and the active adapter selection says 230W. The lower exact selectable GPU figure is used conservatively.
